info.title: OpenQuyHoach API
info.description:
OpenQuyHoach — open, verifiable planning-data infrastructure for Vietnam.

Every entity carries provenance (source artifact sha256, retrieval time,
transformation steps, review state). Derived data is never presented as
official.

get.description: Small GeoJSON pages only — full extents come from tiles, not this API.
"What is planned at this point?" — every hit carries provenance.

post.description: Trigger an ingestion run — inline or via the configured queue.
